mapper.insert: INSERT INTO int_sync_event( source_event_id, task_code, document_no, operation, changed_at, status, execution_id, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{sourceEventId}, #{taskCode}, #{documentNo}, #{action}, #{changedAt}, 'PENDING', NULL, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_event_id = VALUES(source_event_id)
mapper.select: SELECT source_event_id, task_code, document_no, operation, changed_at, status, execution_id FROM int_sync_event WHERE task_code = #{taskCode} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY changed_at, event_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE int_sync_event SET status = 'ACCEPTED', execution_id = #{executionId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE source_event_id = #{sourceEventId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE int_sync_event SET status = 'SUPERSEDED', update_time = NOW() WHERE source_event_id = #{sourceEventId} AND status = 'PENDING'
